summary: Implemented the terminal window title control in the repository. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a two-item (ControlType, str) member in the ControlCode union; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 format entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and the Control.title classmethod; rich/console.py adds set_window_title (terminal check only, returns bool) beside show_cursor/set_alt_screen; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch calling term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md adds an Added heading with one bullet linking PR 2200; tests added to test_console.py, test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only). Nothing was run or committed, and mypy and black were not run. The CHANGELOG PR URL was inferred from the repo name and should be verified.
